I used to think I understood the market well—until it woke me up by making me lose money
When I first entered the crypto space, my biggest problem was being too confident. #ETH 

After getting a few predictions right, I thought I had found a method. Back then, I studied charts every day, watching price movements, and I practically wanted to join every fluctuation.

Later, for a period of time, I made quite a bit in a row.
When the account is up, people get easy to get carried away. At that time, I started to believe there were more and more opportunities, and my positions became bolder and bolder. When I saw a coin spike quickly, I didn’t wait for my trading conditions to be met—I just rushed in.

Then the market suddenly corrected.
At first, I still thought it was fine, because I had profited before, so I felt confident. But when the losses expanded, that’s when I realized: past profits can’t protect you from current mistakes.

After that, I reorganized my trading habits.
First, don’t go in with your full position, and don’t all-in. The market always has surprises. Leaving some room gives me opportunities.

Second, think about risk before opening a trade. Don’t just think about how much you want to make—also consider the maximum loss you can tolerate.

Third, don’t trade against the trend. If the market doesn’t move in your expected direction, don’t force it.

Fourth, accumulate on dips with patience. A “cheap” price isn’t necessarily a good opportunity.

Fifth, don’t chase market hype. When everyone is疯狂, you need to stay calm even more.

Sixth, after a streak of consecutive wins, reduce position size. When you’re making money, it’s easiest to lose respect and caution.

Seventh, after losses, don’t rush to get it back. Emotional trading often leads to even bigger losses.

Eighth, pay attention to changes in volume and price. Whether the price increase has real capital support is extremely important.

Ninth, wait for your own opportunity. Trading every day isn’t the same thing as “working hard.”

The longer I trade, the more I realize one truth:
The market never lacks opportunities—what it lacks are disciplined people.
In the past, I wanted to catch every rise. Now I only want to do my own trades well.

Because trading isn’t a sprint—it’s a long-term survival game. If you want this market to support your life, the most important thing isn’t making money the fastest, but being able to keep going steadily. #BTC  #币圈生存法则  #BeginnerMustRead

我曾经以为自己很懂行情，直到市场让我亏醒
刚进入币圈的时候，我最大的毛病就是太自信。#ETH 

看到几次行情判断对了，就觉得自己找到了方法。那时候每天研究走势，盯着价格变化，恨不得每一次波动都参与。

后来有一段时间，我连续赚了不少。
账户上涨的时候，人很容易飘。那时候我开始觉得机会越来越多，仓位也越来越大胆。看到一个币快速上涨，没有等自己的交易条件出现，就直接冲进去。

结果行情突然调整。
最开始我还觉得没事，因为之前赚过，所以心里有底。后来亏损扩大，我才发现，过去的盈利并不能保护现在的错误。

那次之后，我重新整理自己的交易习惯。
第一，不满仓，不梭哈。市场永远有意外，留一点空间，就是给自己留机会。

第二，开仓之前先想风险。不要只想着赚多少，也要想最多能接受亏多少。

第三，不逆势交易。市场没有按照你的方向走，就不要硬撑。

第四，低吸需要耐心。便宜的价格，不一定就是好的机会。

第五，不追市场热度。所有人都疯狂的时候，更需要保持冷静。

第六，连续盈利以后降低仓位。赚钱的时候，最容易失去敬畏。

第七，亏损以后不要急着翻本。情绪交易，往往会带来更大的亏损。

第八，关注量价变化。价格上涨有没有真实资金支持，非常重要。

第九，等待属于自己的机会。不是每天交易，才叫努力。

做交易时间越久，我越发现一个道理：
市场从来不缺机会，缺的是有纪律的人。
以前我想抓住每一次上涨，现在我只想做好属于自己的交易。

因为交易不是短跑，是一场长期生存。
想靠这个市场养家，最重要的不是赚得最快，而是能够稳定走下去。#BTC

一、以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期支撑价格，多空力量趋于均衡

二〇二六年九月二十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千六百九十二美元，过去数小时在二千六百七十七美元至二千七百美元之间波动。与比特币类似，以太坊在经历了前期的上涨后进入调整阶段，但Glamsterdam升级预期和机构持续增持为价格提供了有力支撑。

A Federal Reserve Board Member Discusses AI Agent Payments｜Lower Fees and Authorization Matter More Than “Which Chain to Choose”｜Before ETH Breaks Above 2720, I’ll Wait

My stance is to observe: I don’t read industry discussions from a central bank official as an official endorsement of Ethereum. In remarks on September 29 about “Payments in the Era of AI Agents,” Federal Reserve Governor Waller did, in fact, mention that stablecoins can improve the potential for cross-border payments. He also said that when AI agents make small payments for things like data and API calls, a payment rail with fixed fees and lower costs is often more suitable. But throughout the speech, he did not specify Ethereum as the settlement network, nor did he announce that the Federal Reserve would purchase ETH, approve a particular public chain, or provide a set of regulatory rules slated to be implemented. Jumping straight from “agents will make payments” to “ETH demand will inevitably surge” skips the real hard parts in between—merchant acceptance, user authorization, anti-fraud measures, clearing routes, and costs.

Waller divides agent business models into two types: assistance and delegation. In the former, humans decide and pay; in the latter, under constraints, the agent handles shopping and payments on their behalf. The delegation model requires stricter trust and guardrails. He specifically raised certification, responsibility allocation, and fraud risk, and noted that cross-border routing would weigh fees, speed, and reliability at the same time. For the crypto market, the opportunity isn’t just issuing an “AI payment coin,” but enabling authorization to be scoped, budgeted, and recorded—so small transactions aren’t swallowed by fees. The Ethereum.org payment documentation also lists stablecoin small-payment scenarios on low-cost Layer 2 networks, indicating there are feasible technical paths. But examples on a website don’t mean real merchant orders have already been scaled, nor does it mean every stablecoin transaction must translate into an equivalent ETH spot buy order.

What I care about most are three choke points for value transfer. First, whether the actual payment route is a bank card, bank instant payment, a private ledger, or an open chain—this speech didn’t pick a winner for the market. Second, even if the route is Ethereum Layer 2, users are paying with stablecoins; ETH may only benefit indirectly through fees, ordering, and settlement—both the amounts and timing still need verification. Third, after an agent receives authorization, if something goes wrong, who can revoke it, enforce limits, and assign accountability often matters more for institutional adoption than raw transactions per second. If later there are official merchant transaction volumes, on-chain fees, and data on funds flowing back to the mainnet, then we can reassess value capture. Don’t chase based on a talk’s headline alone.

Regarding market reaction, I found Binance’s ETH/USDT price at about $2689.61, with the past 24 hours ranging from a high of $2748.60 to a low of $2652.20, up roughly 0.11%. At the moment, there isn’t enough evidence to attribute this price movement to Waller’s speech. Around $2720 is my threshold for observing a short-term repair. If it repeatedly fails to break through, I’ll keep viewing the trend as a rebound within a range. If $2652 breaks and can’t be quickly reclaimed, cautious conditions for longs would be invalidated. If later facts show mainstream agent payments fully bypass the open chain, then my assessment of the mechanisms by which Ethereum benefits should be downgraded.

If this were my own trading plan: I’m not participating now—only considering unleveraged spot long positions. I’d wait for a one-hour close above $2720, then for the next hour to retest $2710 to $2720 without breaking, before deploying 2% of total funds. First target: $2748. Once reached, I’d cut half; the remainder would be watched toward $2790. Initial stop-loss: $2680. If price first drops below $2652, I’d cancel the entry plan. After entry, if two consecutive hourly candles close back below $2710, or if there are abnormal exchange deposits/withdrawals, or if official regulatory documents contradict the direction implied by the speech, I’d close the position—no waiting for targets. If conditions aren’t triggered, it stays a cash-only (no position) plan. I will not turn a scenario into actual filled trades.

Source: Waller’s September 29 official remarks; ethereum.org payment documentation; price: Binance ETH/USDT public quotes. #ETH

The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

美联储理事谈AI代理支付｜低费率与授权比“选哪条链”更关键｜ETH在2720前我先等

我的态度是观察，不把央行理事的行业讨论读成以太坊获官方背书。美联储理事沃勒在9月29日关于“AI代理时代的支付”的讲话中，确实提到稳定币可改善跨境支付的潜力，也谈到AI代理为数据、接口调用等进行小额付款时，更适合固定费用较低的支付轨道。但整篇讲话没有指定以太坊作为结算网络，更没有宣布美联储采购ETH、批准某条公链，或给出一份即将落地的监管规则。把“代理会付款”直接跳成“ETH需求必然爆发”，中间省掉了商户接受、用户授权、反欺诈、清算路线与成本这些真正难的环节。

沃勒把代理商业分成辅助与委托两种模式：前者由人决定并付款，后者在约束条件下让代理代为购物与支付；委托模式需要更严的信任与护栏。他特别提出认证、责任归属和欺诈风险，并指出跨境路由会同时权衡费用、速度和可靠性。对加密市场而言，机会不只是发行一个“AI支付币”，而是让授权有范围、有预算、有记录，并让小额交易不被手续费吞掉。以太坊官网支付说明也列出低成本二层网络上的稳定币小额支付场景，说明技术上存在可行路径；但官网举例不等于真实商户订单已经规模化，更不等于每笔稳定币交易都必须在ETH现货形成等额买盘。

我更关心收益传导的三个关口。第一，实际付款走银行卡、银行即时支付、私有账本还是开放链，讲话并未替市场选定。第二，即便选择以太坊二层，用户付的是稳定币，ETH可能只通过手续费、排序和结算间接受益，金额与时滞都要核实。第三，代理获得授权后若出错，谁能撤销、限额、追责，往往比每秒处理量更影响机构采用。若今后有正式商户交易量、链上费用和回流主网的数据，再评估价值捕获；仅凭演讲标题不追涨。

市场反应方面，我查到币安ETH/USDT约2689.61美元，滚动24小时高2748.60、低2652.20，涨幅约0.11%。目前没有足够证据把这段价格变化归因于沃勒讲话。2720美元附近是我观察短线修复的门槛；如果反复冲不过去，仍把走势看成区间内反弹。2652附近若失守且无法快速收回，偏谨慎的条件多头假设被推翻；如果后续事实证明主流代理支付完全绕开开放链，以太坊受益的机制判断也需下调。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，只考虑无杠杆现货多单。要等一小时收盘站上2720美元，下一小时回踩2710至2720不破，才投入总资金的2%；第一目标2748美元，达到后减仓一半，剩余看2790美元。初始止损设在2680美元；若先跌破2652美元，取消入场计划。入场后若连续两根小时线收回2710下方，或出现交易所充提异常、监管正式文件与讲话方向相反，就平仓，不等目标。条件未触发就是空仓，绝不把设想写成实际成交。

来源：美联储沃勒9月29日正式讲话、ethereum.org支付说明；价格：币安ETH/USDT公开行情。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Imperium, a DeFi subsidiary under BTCS, recently stated that they have completed compliance preparations for an application to the SEC for a “regulated entity exemption.” Although they have already filed the necessary notices and published the relevant disclosures, Imperium has not yet started offering stock-related token liquidity services. This is because, to provide such services, a qualified Tokenized Securities Venue (a tokenized securities trading venue) must first be up and running.

Why is this news important?
Imperium’s compliance move shows BTCS’s ambition in the tokenized securities market—but more importantly, it exposes a contradiction in market development: preparations for regulatory compliance are accelerating, but the actual market infrastructure is not yet ready. BTCS’s behavior is more like a strategic contingency plan in case the tokenized securities market suddenly gains traction. Why does that matter? Because it means regulatory and market timelines are not aligned—regulators (the SEC) are drafting the rules, while market participants begin preparing themselves before the rules are clearly defined.

Impact on the market
In the short term, BTCS’s compliance preparations may boost market sentiment, since more compliant participants generally mean greater transparency. But the long-term impact depends on when the tokenized securities market actually launches. If it keeps getting delayed, then BTCS’s preparations may end up as just costs. It’s like automakers developing electric-vehicle charging stations in advance—if the charging network still can’t roll out, the automakers’ efforts may be wasted. 1.8 billion USD liquidated in a day. $BTC  and $ETH  are both involved; the culprit isn’t bad news.

That’s a chain-liquidation event. Many people join the long side with high leverage—when the price retreats only slightly, the weakest leveraged positions hit the bottom.

The exchange automatically triggers the liquidation orders. Closing orders add more sell pressure, pushing the price down further and triggering the next round of margin calls. No one has to actually sell—if the server does its job, that’s enough.

On 23/09, derivatives recorded about 1.8 billion USD worth of liquidations within 24 hours, according to FXStreet. The Block calls this the strongest altcoin liquidation event since 2021.

Before that, the funding rate had been positive for many days—a sign that the long side was paying to keep positions open, with the crowd clearly skewed to one side. The more lopsided it is, the cleaner the collapse.

What proves I’m wrong: if the funding rate has already returned close to 0 but the price still doesn’t bounce, then this is no longer just excessive leverage. At that point, real money is withdrawing—this is a demand issue, not a technical problem caused by leverage.

Key marker to watch: how quickly the total open interest across the whole market replenishes after the sell-off. Fast reloading means nothing has been learned yet; slow reloading is a more stable temporary bottom.

This mechanism doesn’t distinguish between big coins and small coins, or between good news and bad news. It only needs a sufficiently large crowd betting on the same direction with high enough leverage.

Brothers and friends, ask yourselves again: are you opening your position because you believe in the trend, or because you’re afraid of missing out when you see others just profiting?

Personal observation, not investment advice

1,8 tỷ đô thanh lý một ngày. $BTC và $ETH đều dính, thủ phạm không phải tin xấu.

Đó là chuỗi thanh lý dây chuyền. Đông người cùng mở long với đòn bẩy cao, giá chỉ lùi nhẹ là ký quỹ lô yếu nhất chạm đáy.

Sàn tự đóng lệnh đó. Lệnh đóng tạo thêm áp lực bán, đẩy giá lùi tiếp, chạm ký quỹ lô kế tiếp. Không cần ai bán thật, chỉ cần máy chủ làm đúng việc.

Hôm 23/09, phái sinh ghi nhận khoảng 1,8 tỷ đô thanh lý trong 24 giờ, theo FXStreet. The Block gọi đây là đợt thanh lý altcoin mạnh nhất kể từ 2021.

Trước đó, phí tài trợ (funding rate) đã dương cao nhiều ngày — dấu hiệu bên long đang trả tiền để giữ lệnh, đám đông lệch hẳn một phía. Càng lệch, cú sập càng gọn.

Điều gì chứng minh mình sai: nếu phí tài trợ đã về gần 0 mà giá vẫn không hồi, thì đây không còn là chuyện đòn bẩy quá tay. Lúc đó dòng tiền thật đang rút, một vấn đề về nhu cầu, không phải trục trặc kỹ thuật của đòn bẩy.

Mốc đáng theo dõi: khối lượng hợp đồng mở toàn thị trường có chất lại nhanh sau cú xả không. Chất nhanh là chưa học được gì, chất chậm mới là đáy tạm ổn định hơn.

Cơ chế này không phân biệt coin lớn nhỏ, không phân biệt tin tốt xấu. Nó chỉ cần một đám đông đủ đông cùng đặt cược một hướng với đòn bẩy đủ cao.

二〇二六年九月二十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千六百九十五美元，过去数小时在二千六百七十至二千七百美元区间内窄幅整理。ETH在经历前期调整后，目前在二千七百美元下方形成了相对稳定的支撑区域，市场等待即将到来的Glamsterdam升级作为新的催化剂。

二、技术指标全面解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百九十二点六七美元，二十五小时均线报二千六百九十一点八三美元，九十九小时均线报二千六百八十七点五四美元。三条均线高度粘合，差距不足五美元，表明市场正处于方向选择的关键时刻。价格目前略高于所有主要均线，短期多头略占优势，但优势并不明显。

MACD指标方面，快线报二点五三，慢线报五点七七，柱状图为负三点二四。MACD快线虽处于零轴上方，但已低于慢线形成死叉，柱状图为负值且持续扩大，显示短期动能偏弱。不过快线绝对值仍为正值，表明中期趋势尚未完全转空。

In the crypto market, I often call myself a “fool.”
#ETH 
With small capital, I’ve multiplied it several times—never liquidated, never chasing the hottest trends, and even too lazy to stare at the candlestick chart repeatedly. People around me say I’m lucky. But they don’t understand: “being a fool” is the most reliable moat in this market.

There are too many smart people. They rotate positions every three minutes, the moment a good-catalyst signal appears they all rush in. In futures, they max the leverage to bet on direction. After only a slight pullback, the account goes straight to zero.

They’re not that they don’t understand technical analysis—quite the opposite: they understand too much. They move too fast, and their greed is too great. They always want to eat everything in one bite.

I’m the opposite.
A few steps: start with a tiny position to probe the market first, and only trade opportunities where the uptrend is just beginning and the certainty is high.

I don’t touch trash coins, and I don’t bother with half-hearted excitement from the news. Place a small base position, then wait slowly.

If you can’t hold on, you don’t have the right to make money. When the market finally calms down and the price action is completely confirmed, then take a portion of your funds to follow in. Let the main force buy at the bottom—I only take the most stable segment.

After one cycle of the market, I withdraw my funds. I don’t dream about consecutive green days, and I don’t “fall in love” with any coin. To me, the crypto market is a cash machine: take the money, turn around, and leave.

This strategy isn’t glamorous at all, but it works—plain and simple.
A while back, a brother of mine lost money until he was close to breaking down. He said he never wants to play smart tricks again. He followed this method for a while—he not only got back to even, but also earned enough to buy a new car.

Another fan started with a small amount of capital. By relying on patience and splitting entries, he managed to grow it into a solid number. He said if he had known, he wouldn’t have messed around so carelessly back then.

The crypto market has never been a game for trading brilliance—it’s a hellscape of emotion control and position management. If you lose money, it’s never because you can’t read candlesticks. It’s because your heart is too impatient, your position is too big, and your head is too stubborn.

After reading this, you have two paths: keep losing money over and over by relying on tricks, or “play dumb” like I do—put the steady money into your pocket.

币圈里，我常说自己是个“傻子”。
#ETH 
小资金翻了好几倍，从没爆过仓，从不追热点，连K线都懒得反复盯。身边人都说我运气好，其实他们不懂：“傻”，才是这个市场最稳的护城河。

聪明人太多了。三分钟换一次仓，利好刚冒头就一窝蜂冲进去，合约拉满赌方向。一个小幅回踩，账户直接归零。

他们不是不懂技术，恰恰是懂太多：手太快、心太贪，总想一口吃成胖子。

我刚好反过来。
办法就几步：极小仓位先探路，只做趋势刚冒头、确定性高的机会。

垃圾币不碰，消息面的热闹半分不凑。丢个底仓进去，然后慢慢等。

熬不住的人，根本没资格赚钱。等市场彻底躁动、走势完全确认，再拿一部分资金跟进。底部让主力去抄，我只吃最稳的那一段。

一轮行情走完就出金。不做连涨的美梦，也不跟任何币种“谈恋爱”。币圈对我来说就是提款机，取完钱转身就走。

这套打法一点都不帅，但实打实管用。
之前有个兄弟亏到快崩溃，说再也不想耍小聪明了。跟着这套方法走了一段时间，不仅回了本，还赚够钱换了新车。

还有个粉丝拿小资金起步，靠耐心和分仓，硬生生滚到了不错的数字。他说早知道当初就不瞎折腾了。

币圈从来不是拼技术的赛场，是拼情绪管控和仓位管理的修罗场。你亏钱，从来不是输在不会看K线，是输在心太急、仓太满、头太铁。

看完这篇，你有两条路：继续靠小聪明反复亏钱，或者跟我一样“装傻”，把稳稳的钱揣进兜里。

SEC tokenized-stock exemption brought up again | Permissioned trading doesn’t specify Ethereum | Before ETH confirms at 2710, I’ll wait

My stance is still cautious—I won’t directly translate the policy space for “stock tokenization” into spot ETH buy pressure. On Binance Square today, the trending topics are earnings reports, NEAR spot ETFs, and U.S. job openings; none of them are the correct topic tags for this rule, so I won’t borrow tags for this post. When Binance News again mentions the SEC chair supporting on-chain securities, I go back to the original SEC document to verify: the September 17 commission release is a temporary, condition-attached “innovative exemption.” It allows tokenized security trading venues that meet the criteria, within a permissioned environment, to trade a portion of tokenized U.S.-listed stocks using automated market making and liquidity-pool trades, and provides corresponding exemptions for specified liquidity providers. It is not a brand-new law passed today, and it does not designate Ethereum as the only settlement chain.

The key limitations matter more than slogans. The SEC chair’s explanation states that venues must comply with sanctions requirements; participants are subject to permissioned access; the relevant stock tokens must retain the traditional stock’s dividends and voting rights; and issuers can also oppose the trading. Anti-fraud and anti-manipulation rules continue to apply. This kind of regulatory experiment may increase demand for on-chain clearing, custody, identity verification, and compliance tooling—but ultimately which chain to deploy on, whether to use a public chain, and whether trading volume is sufficient to create ETH fuel fees and burn, all depend on the venue’s and issuer’s formal choices. If trading is concentrated on permissioned chains or other networks, the transmission effect to ETH spot would be weak. Calling this “an approved trial” and claiming “Wall Street is already buying massive amounts of ETH” skips the most important evidence in between.

Market reactions also can’t be treated backward as cause and effect. This morning Beijing time, Binance ETHUSDT is around $2691, up about 0.68% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $2652 to $2749. This quote only shows price action is still within the range; it cannot prove that the move higher was driven by the September 17 filing. Farside’s September 29 Ethereum ETF page still shows dashes across each fund; the automatically displayed total of zero cannot be treated as final “zero net inflow.” And the recent full September 28 total of about $17.1 million net inflow also can’t be extrapolated to mean today’s money continues to pour in.

If I were trading it myself, I wouldn’t chase price. My direction would be preset: a small, unleveraged spot long position. Only if an ETH hourly close is above $2710, then pulls back to $2700–$2710 without breaking, and after seeing fund data update there isn’t clear weakening—then I’d consider a tentative position up to at most 0.3% of total funds. First target: $2748 to cut the position in half. Second target: $2780 to exit fully. If after entry it breaks below $2675, I’d execute a hard stop loss; or if two consecutive hours close below $2700, I’d close early. If before any trigger it drops below $2652, the entire long plan is canceled. Even if price breaks higher, if subsequent venue announcements make it clear they won’t use Ethereum, or if on-chain actual fees and usage don’t catch up for a long time, I would overturn the “ETH benefits” inference and won’t add to the position to bet on the narrative. What’s written here is a conditional plan—not a deal already made or money already earned.

Source check: SEC September 17 announcement and chair’s statement; Farside Ethereum ETF item-by-item table; Binance ETHUSDT rolling 24-hour行情.
#ETH
The above is for personal market observation only and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度仍是谨慎，不把“股票上链”的政策空间直接换算成ETH买盘。币安广场今天的热门话题集中在财报、NEAR现货ETF和美国职位空缺；它们都不是这项规则的准确话题标签，所以这篇不借标签。币安新闻再提SEC主席支持证券市场上链，我回到SEC原文件核对：9月17日委员会发布的是临时、附条件的“创新豁免”，允许符合条件的代币化证券交易场所，在许可环境内以自动做市和流动性池交易部分代币化美国上市股票，并对特定流动性提供者作相应豁免。它不是今天刚通过的新法，也没有指定以太坊为唯一结算链。

关键限制比口号重要。SEC主席的说明写明场所须遵守制裁要求，参与者受许可准入约束，相关股票代币应保留传统股票的股息和投票权，发行人还可以反对交易；反欺诈、反操纵规则继续适用。这样的制度试验可能增加链上清算、托管、身份验证和合规工具需求，但最终在哪条链部署、是否用公链、交易量是否足以形成ETH燃料费与销毁，都要看场所与发行人的正式选择。若交易集中在许可链或其他网络，对ETH现货的传导就很弱；把“获准试验”说成“华尔街已经大规模买ETH”，中间跳过了最重要的证据。

市场反应也不能倒因为果。北京时间今晨03:44币安ETHUSDT约2691美元，滚动24小时约涨0.68%，区间2652至2749美元。这个报价只说明盘面仍在区间内，无法证明上涨由这份9月17日文件驱动。Farside的9月29日以太坊ETF各基金一栏仍是破折号，页面自动显示的合计零值不能当作最终零流入；最近完整的9月28日合计约净流入1710万美元，也不能外推成今天资金继续涌入。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追价，方向只预设无杠杆现货小仓做多。只有ETH一小时收盘站上2710美元，回踩2700至2710美元不破，并看到基金数据更新后不出现明显转弱，才考虑总资金最多0.3%的试探仓；第一目标2748美元先减半，第二目标2780美元清仓。若入场后跌破2675美元执行硬止损，或连续两小时收在2700美元下方提前平仓；触发前若先跌破2652美元，整套多头计划取消。即使价格上破，若后续场所公告明确不采用以太坊，或链上实际费用与使用量迟迟不跟进，我会推翻“ETH受益”的推断，不加仓赌叙事。这里写的是条件计划，不是已经成交或赚到钱。

Asset management giant WisdomTree has consolidated its digital asset line into a new brand, WisdomTree Onchain. The total size of its tokenized funds has surpassed $1.2 billion, up significantly from roughly $770 million at the start of 2026.

The company now has 15 SEC-registered tokenized funds, covering money market, equities, fixed income, asset allocation, and alternative strategies. They run across eight blockchain networks: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, Plume, Solana, and Stellar. It splits its products into four parts: Prime App for retail users; a Connect interface for institutions and distribution partners; an on-chain transfer agent that handles share issuance and servicing; and Onchain Markets, a secondary trading marketplace that is still under development.

What’s interesting is that use cases have already started to take shape. Stablecoin issuers can place reserves into the tokenized money-market fund WTGXX; corporate treasuries can use it to manage operating cash; and institutions are researching ways to keep collateral moving continuously across permissioned wallets, no longer constrained by banking business hours.

From buying exposure to redoing trade settlement and clearing, traditional asset management’s steps toward going on-chain are getting bigger. The wider the channels are laid out, the closer the day assets can be put openly on the table becomes.#ETH #代币化 #RWA #加密市场

📰 Just now, it was said that AI is driving inflation up—now the Fed has also warned about AI security. What exactly is the crypto market afraid of?

Fed Governor Waller publicly supports AI, stablecoins, and tokenization, saying this is the future of payments. He admits that traditional finance is lagging and must embrace technology. For the crypto community, this counts as the regulator’s first such high-level acknowledgment that crypto technology can improve existing systems—and in the future, it may directly participate in designing the rules. This is a direct positive for BTC and ETH, especially projects with AI/stablecoin business models.

Why is this news important?
Waller’s comments are not just “crypto is good.” From the perspective of the U.S. central bank, it acknowledges that the current financial system needs AI and crypto technology to upgrade. That means regulation could shift from “blocking” to “guiding.” In the future, regulators may even work with Crypto companies to pilot programs. The core reason is that the U.S. wants to maintain its lead in financial technology. As Europe and Asia are aggressively developing their own Crypto, the Fed’s outreach this time is proactive. Compared with earlier emphasis on regulatory risks, it signals that the regulatory environment is starting to warm up.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH, this is a major positive. As “digital gold,” BTC may play a larger role in payment systems going forward. As the platform for smart contracts, ETH, with Waller’s support, could accelerate institutional adoption of Layer 2. In the short term, market sentiment could surge wildly—but it remains to be seen whether this can turn into actual inflows. A historical reference is 2019, when the EU first acknowledged the importance of Blockchain technology; the market rebounded by about 20% then. Right now, BTC and ETH are both at critical levels, and Waller’s remarks may break the stalemate.

Trading ideas
💡 This wave is bullish. If the Fed truly starts collaborating with Crypto companies on pilots, BTC could find support around $85K–$87K, but the logic that it falls below $82K would not hold. This means the regulatory shift will need time to be validated, but early sentiment could be very strong.

以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期支撑价格底部

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月三十日凌晨，以太坊报价二千六百七十四点二九美元，近期经历了一轮从二千七百二十六美元高位回落的调整行情。从小时K线来看，价格从二千七百二十六美元快速下探至二千六百六十八美元附近，随后在二千六百七十美元一线反复震荡整理，最新一根小时K线收于二千六百八十五点七二美元，显示出一定的企稳反弹迹象。

以太坊此次回调同样受到宏观环境的影响，美国十年期国债收益率攀升至十九年高位对整体风险资产形成压制。不过从基本面来看，以太坊拥有独特的利好催化剂。Glamsterdam升级已确定将于十月六日在Sepolia测试网上激活，这一重要升级将提升网络的可扩展性和安全性。Vitalik Buterin近期表示以太坊正在超越传统区块链的范畴，进化为加密世界计算机，这一愿景为以太坊的中长期发展奠定了坚实基础。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百九十七点七六美元，二十五小时均线报二千六百九十一点七七美元，九十九小时均线报二千六百八十七点三七美元。当前价格略低于短期均线但接近长期均线支撑，三条均线之间的间距较窄，显示市场正在蓄势。布林带上轨位于二千七百四十二点四五美元，中轨位于二千六百九十三点八十一美元，下轨位于二千六百四十五点一六美元，价格在中轨附近运行。

MACD指标显示空头动能持续释放，MACD柱状图读数为负四点零七，信号线位于六点四二，两者差距有所扩大，短期仍需关注动能是否收敛。RSI六周期指标从零下二十九的超卖区域回升至四十二点三零，虽然尚未脱离弱势区域，但已经显示出底部反弹的迹象。KDJ指标中K值为二十四点五一，D值为三十八点六四，J值为负三点七三，整体处于低位区域。

威廉指标从零下八十点八二的深度超卖区域回升至零下六十七点九零，配合RSI的底部回升，技术面正在酝酿反弹信号。ATR十四周期指标报二十点二九，波动率保持在合理范围内。

三、市场情绪分析

从币安AI信号系统来看，以太坊的多空力量对比明显优于比特币。十五个因子中有八个发出看多信号，六个发出看空信号，一个中性信号，多头因子占比达到百分之五十三点三三。综合指标维持看多判断，整体胜率高达百分之七十二点三四，其中做多胜率为百分之七十点七三，显示市场对以太坊的中期走势相对乐观。

基本面方面，美国主要交易所获得CFTC数字资产衍生品清算批准，以太坊ETF日均流入达一千七百一十万美元，企业国库质押超过六百万枚ETH，这些机构层面的持续布局为以太坊提供了强劲的需求支撑。不过需要注意的是，近期链上出现大额转账至交易所的情况，包括单笔两万枚ETH的转入，可能存在一定的抛压风险。

此外，Bitget安全事件中黑客正在将盗取的资产转换为比特币，这也给以太坊市场带来了一定的局部卖压。但从更长周期来看，Glamsterdam升级的推进和机构质押需求的增长将继续为以太坊提供上行动力。建议投资者关注二千六百四十五美元布林下轨的支撑力度，以及二千七百四十二美元布林上轨的阻力表现。

Bitmine’s ETH holdings top 6 million! Only one step away from its “5%” target 

Bitmine added to its position again.
As of September 27, Bitmine holds 6,001,302 ETH. Based on the company’s disclosed reference price of $2,698, the value of its holdings is about $16.2 billion.

More importantly—
👉 This is roughly 4.9% of Ethereum’s supply
👉 It’s only about 104,000 ETH away from its “hold 5% ETH” goal
👉 It bought another 17,362 ETH in the past week

And this isn’t just plain “hoarding.”
Bitmine currently has 5.067 million ETH staked, accounting for about 84% of its ETH holdings. The company expects annualized revenue from its staking business of about $358 million.

What’s truly worth paying attention to is an increasingly clear trend:
Businesses are turning ETH from a “trading asset” into a strategic reserve on the balance sheet for the long term.
In the past, it was MicroStrategy constantly buying BTC; now we’re seeing something like Bitmine’s “ETH Treasury.”

And since Bitmine launched its ETH Treasury Strategy in June 2025, it has been buying ETH every week in a row. In under 15 months, it has surpassed 6 million ETH.

Next, the most值得 watch are:
① When Bitmine will actually reach its 5% target
② Whether enterprise-level ETH Treasury will continue to expand
③ After large amounts of ETH are staked, what impact will it have on market liquidity

Six million ETH is just a number—the bigger story is that ETH is being treated by more and more institutions as a long-term asset allocation.

Bitmine持仓突破600万ETH！距离“5%”目标只差一步 

Bitmine这次又加仓了。
截至9月27日，Bitmine持有 6,001,302枚ETH，按照公司披露的参考价格2698美元计算，持仓价值约 162亿美元。

更关键的是——
👉 这相当于以太坊供应量的约 4.9%
👉 距离它提出的“持有5% ETH”目标，只差约 10.4万枚ETH
👉 最近一周又买入了 17,362枚ETH

而且这不是单纯“囤币”。
Bitmine目前已经有 506.7万枚ETH处于质押状态，约占其ETH持仓的84%。公司预计目前质押业务年化收入约 3.58亿美元。

这件事真正值得关注的，是一个越来越明显的趋势：
企业正在把ETH从“交易资产”，变成长期资产负债表上的战略储备。
过去是MicroStrategy不断买BTC，现在则出现了Bitmine这样的“ETH Treasury”。

而且Bitmine从2025年6月启动ETH Treasury Strategy以来，已经连续每周买入ETH。不到15个月，就突破600万枚。

接下来最值得看的就是：
① Bitmine什么时候真正达到5%目标
② 企业级ETH Treasury会不会继续扩张
③ 大量ETH进入质押后，对市场流动性会产生什么影响

6百万ETH只是一个数字，背后更值得关注的是：ETH正在被越来越多机构当成长期资产配置。
